Backend: test_concurrency.py passed 12/12 and test_record_store_edge.py passed 7/7. A) Daily Report: all checks passed. I created 4 TEST production entries (today: TEST_OpA 5+7 and TEST_OpB 3; yesterday: TEST_OpA 4). Today showed 2 grouped rows (12 and 3) with total 15. Yesterday showed 1 row of 4. Custom range 2026-10-01..2026-11-05 showed 377 rows and 14473, which matches the API/Mongo sum. Rows were sorted newest first across 33 dates. Reversing from/to gave the same result. Each filter total matched the API: JC-026 = 1379, JC-026 + PT HV Winding = 491, + Veerpal = 133, HV COIL only = 1161, Today + TEST_OpB = 3. Excel export has the 6 columns and a Total row (verified with openpyxl). Print/PDF downloads production-daily-<date>.pdf. Empty ranges disable Export. The production role can open the report. B) Concurrency retest: B1 (HIGH) is FIXED. In the replayed batch after re-login, the panel showed vendorInvoiceNo opened=TEST_INV0 / mine=TEST_INV0 / theirs=TEST_B3 and vendorInvoiceAmount 100/888/100. Re-apply saved TEST_B3 + 888. B2 is FIXED for the normal case: 1 GET /erp/state on reload, and the replayed GRN edit and stock were visible within 3s. B3 is FIXED: Item conflict 'Reload latest' left 0 'Updated item' logs and the server kept B's minStock=7 and saleRate 0. B4 is FIXED: the panel shows the other user's field (minStock 5/5/7) and no currentStock row. NEW MEDIUM bug: a replayed batch whose opId the server had already applied double-counts stock in the UI. Repro: the commit reaches the server but the response is lost (or the beforeunload flush lands just before the reload's GET /erp/state). Server stock was 389 (correct, applied once) but the UI showed 390 and stayed wrong after 16s+ until a full reload. All test data was cleaned up.

minor.issue: Still uses a per-process asyncio.Lock (known; no regression). The idempotent replay returns the stored result correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: MEDIUM. If the unsaved batch was already committed on the server (response lost, or the beforeunload flush landed before the reload's fetchState), hydrate applies the 'inc' ops again on top of server state that already includes them. The idempotent commit returns ok, baseRef is set to that doubled snapshot, and pull() finds no changes. Item stock in the UI stays at +delta (server 389, UI 390) until the next full reload. Upserts are idempotent, so only stock (inc) is affected. Repro: in Playwright, route /api/erp/commit with route.fetch() then route.abort(), edit the GRN qty, then reload. The re-login replay path has the same logic.

LOW. 'Today' uses todayISO(), which is the UTC date (toISOString). 'Yesterday' uses the local date (isoD(new Date()-1)). In IST between 00:00 and 05:30, Today and Yesterday resolve to the SAME date and the real local today is not reachable. Use one consistent date source; the entry-date logic should also match.

LOW. JC, Stage and Operator filter values persist when the date mode/range changes. If the chosen value is not among the new range's options, the select shows a mismatched value while still filtering (can show an empty list without an obvious reason). Reset the filters or keep the selected value in the options.

issues: The Total Qty and Operator columns are pushed off-screen, so you must scroll horizontally to see the qty. Consider a compact layout or a sticky qty column.

For fields the user did NOT change (e.g. vendorInvoiceNo), the 'Your change' column still shows the old value styled as a change, which reads as if the user wants the old value. Consider showing '(unchanged)' or greying it out when mineChanged is false.

action_items: MEDIUM: Prevent double stock after replaying an already-applied batch. Options: have the server flag idempotent hits (e.g. replayed:true) and re-fetch /erp/state and adopt() after them; always adopt a fresh state after a replay commit succeeds; or do not apply 'inc' ops locally during hydrate and let the pull bring the stock.
LOW: Use one date source (local date) for Today and Yesterday in DailyReportModal, and keep it consistent with how productionEntries.date is written.
LOW: Reset the Daily Report filters when the mode/range changes, or keep stale selected values as options.
LOW: In the Conflict panel, visually mark fields the user did not change.

rca of the issue: Replay double stock: hydrateFromServer -> adopt(server state that already contains the batch) -> applyOpsLocally(saved.ops) re-applies the inc delta -> commit with the same opId returns the cached ok result -> flushSave sets baseRef = snapshot (doubled) -> pull() sees no new versions, so local and base stay doubled. Daily Report today/yesterday: todayISO() is UTC-based while the yesterday calculation is local-based.
